policy: Evidence-grounded concepts; themes and actions are optional; unknown is allowed. Named figures require contextual identity. No doctrinal or identity implication follows from similarity.

concepts.label: Impermanence
concepts.definition: The passing, fragility or unreliability of worldly life or possessions.
exclude: Any mention of time without transience.

concepts.label: Longing and separation
concepts.definition: Yearning for presence, meeting or reunion; distress at absence of the beloved or sought one.
exclude: Praise or affection alone.

concepts.label: Refuge and protection
concepts.definition: Seeking, granting or relying on shelter, rescue or protection.
exclude: A passing honorific meaning protector without thematic development.

concepts.label: Grace
concepts.definition: Favor or compassionate help enabling the seeker or transforming life; whether it is merited is not assumed.
exclude: Generic divine praise without help or favor.

concepts.label: Devoted service
concepts.definition: Doing the beloved, teacher or divine purpose; attending to another as devoted service.
exclude: Artist or professional service credits.

concepts.label: Divine presence and pervasion
concepts.definition: The divine encountered within the person, throughout the world or in all beings.
exclude: Automatically infer a particular nondual doctrine.

concepts.label: Limits of knowing
concepts.definition: The inability of thought, speech or senses to encompass the addressed reality.
exclude: Merely asking for knowledge.

concepts.label: Liberation
concepts.definition: Release from bondage, rebirth or constrained existence as the text understands it.
exclude: Ordinary relief from one practical difficulty.

concepts.label: Guidance
concepts.definition: Being taught, led, awakened or guided by a teacher or divine presence.
exclude: Every mention of Guru.

concepts.label: Surrender
concepts.definition: Yielding control, ownership or self-reliance to the beloved, teacher or divine.
exclude: Any request for practical help.

concepts.label: Awakening
concepts.definition: Coming out of sleep, delusion or unawareness as a spiritual transformation.
exclude: A literal morning wakeup with no spiritual implication.

concepts.label: Gratitude
concepts.definition: Acknowledging received goodness, help or favor with thanks.
exclude: Praise alone without received goodness.

concepts.label: Devotional joy
concepts.definition: Joy, delight, celebration or bliss as a substantial lyric theme.
exclude: Energetic audio or a single auspicious epithet.

concepts.label: Compassion
concepts.definition: Concern for suffering and kindness toward another, or appeal to that concern.
exclude: All statements of divine power.

concepts.label: Ethical conduct
concepts.definition: Instruction, reflection or commitment concerning how one should act toward others or order life.
exclude: Importing a moral from an unrelated narrative.

concepts.label: Detachment
concepts.definition: Letting go of craving, possessiveness or worldly attachment.
exclude: Any occurrence of the word world.

concepts.label: Critique of outward ritual
concepts.definition: Questioning external observances when detached from inward understanding or devotion.
exclude: Ritual performance itself or a blanket rejection of ritual.

concepts.label: Loving relationship
concepts.definition: An intimate loving relation to the addressed or narrated beloved.
exclude: Inferring romantic identity or a specific deity from beloved alone.

concepts.label: Humility and limitation
concepts.definition: Recognizing personal inadequacy, dependence, lowliness or fallibility.
exclude: A conventional signature without developed humility.

concepts.label: The name and its efficacy
concepts.definition: The significance or transformative power of divine or teacher names.
exclude: One name mentioned as identification.

concepts.label: Beauty and divine form
concepts.definition: Sustained contemplation or description of beauty, adornment or embodied form.
exclude: One adjective in a list.

concepts.label: Creation and cosmic order
concepts.definition: Origin, sustaining or dissolution of the cosmos or order of existence.
exclude: Every mention of earth or sky.

concepts.label: Shared dignity and inclusion
concepts.definition: Equal regard, inclusion or rejection of hierarchy between people.
exclude: Assuming an egalitarian message from an author or tradition.

concepts.label: Meeting and arrival
concepts.definition: Arrival, encounter, reunion or welcoming as the lyric focus.
exclude: Merely naming a place.

concepts.label: Praise
concepts.definition: Extolling, hailing or worshipping the addressed or narrated subject.
exclude: Poet or performer credit.

concepts.label: Petition
concepts.definition: Asking the addressed other for a specific gift, action, help or transformation.
exclude: A narrator reporting someone else asked, without retaining narrative role.

concepts.label: Meditation and attention
concepts.definition: Directing or steadying attention in contemplation.
exclude: Automatically convert attention to audible chanting.

concepts.label: Remembrance and name repetition
concepts.definition: Remembering or repeating an addressed name or teaching.
exclude: Name used only for identification.

concepts.label: Invitation
concepts.definition: Calling or inviting someone to come, enter, stay or appear.
exclude: Any statement that someone exists.

concepts.label: Offering
concepts.definition: Presenting worship, self, objects or acts to another.
exclude: Generic praise with no offering.

concepts.label: Pilgrimage and devotional journey
concepts.definition: Going toward a sacred place, gathering or sought presence as devotional practice.
exclude: Any place-name.
